premises.text: Pregnancy complications are rising and prenatal checkups are inconvenient, expensive, and limited by outdated technology that leaves moms uncertain

premises.text: A medical-grade wearable sensor plus app measures biopotentials to give moms real-time contraction and pregnancy information and better doctor communication

premises.text: The same sensor can track key maternal and fetal parameters including fetal movement and heart rate via software updates without new hardware
premises.evidence_span: our amazing, lightweight, medical-grade sensor can measure the most important health parameters of mom and baby from conception to birth

premises.text: Direct-to-consumer monthly subscription provides reusable sensor and disposable patches, with later channel partnerships, FDA clearance, and reimbursement toward standard of care

secondary_value.text: Peace of mind and need-to-know body/baby information for expecting moms
